title: Snowflake August 2026 behavior change bundle
summary: Governance, Dynamic Tables metrics, and SQL function hardening land in the August bundle—review before enabling in prod accounts.
whatChanged: Improved Dynamic Tables lag and refresh cost metrics in ACCOUNT_USAGE
Stricter default privileges on newly created schemas in some editions
New SQL functions for safer date/time truncation patterns
Cortex Search indexing limits raised for mid-size document corpora
whyReadNow: Behavior change bundles can alter privilege defaults and cost signals. Skim before your next maintenance window so CI and IaC stay aligned.

title: Databricks Runtime 16: Photon + Spark Connect highlights
summary: DBR 16 tightens Photon coverage for common SQL/Python workloads and improves Spark Connect session reliability for notebook clients.
whatChanged: Broader Photon acceleration for window and aggregate plans
Spark Connect Python client stability and auth refresh fixes
Delta liquid clustering recommendations updated in docs
Better default shuffle partitions heuristics for serverless jobs
whyReadNow: If you pin runtime versions in job clusters, plan an upgrade path and re-benchmark critical ETL before rolling fleet-wide.

title: PySpark 4.0 preview: Connect-first and typing cleanup
summary: Preview notes emphasize Spark Connect as a first-class path and cleaner type stubs for DataFrame APIs used in IDE-heavy workflows.
whatChanged: Connect client APIs promoted for day-1 Python development
Improved py.typed stubs for Column and DataFrame methods
Deprecation warnings for legacy RDD-heavy examples in docs
Performance notes for Arrow-backed pandas conversion paths
whyReadNow: Worth a read if you maintain internal PySpark wrappers—type stubs and Connect assumptions may affect your next major bump.

title: Python 3.13.2 patch release
summary: Security and bugfix release—update base images used by Airflow/DBT containers and Databricks custom environments when feasible.
whatChanged: Security fixes in stdlib networking helpers
asyncio edge-case fixes relevant to lightweight workers
whyReadNow: Patch releases are low-drama upgrades that close CVEs in shared CI images—schedule alongside your next image rebuild.
